JDU Internal Conflict:bihar vidhan parishad (MLC) chunav parinamon ke bad janta dal (yunaited) yani jediyu (JDU) ke andar chal raha andruni vivad aur netaon ke bich ki aapsi kalah khulkar samne aa gaee hai. is taja rajnitik ghamasan men lalan sinh (Lalan Singh), sanjay jha (Sanjay Jha), niraj kumar (Neeraj Kumar) aur nishkasit neta anant sinh (Anant Singh) ke bich tikhi khinchtan dekhne ko mil rahi hai.
